source.title: Mid-Ulster Mail, 1 December 1973, p. 1 ("Loyalists gain seat"); Belfast Telegraph, 30 November 1973, p. 2 ("Cookstown by-election result (Loyalist Coalition win)"); Mid-Ulster Mail, 13 October 1973, p. 13 ("BY-ELECTION FOR VACANT SEAT")
source.publisher: Mid-Ulster Mail / Belfast Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: 2,751-1,874=877, the printed majority. Valid 4,625 (sum); +81 spoilt = 4,706 total (derived); 78.8 pc printed, implying an electorate of about 5,970. Quota floor(4,625/2)+1 = 2,313 (derived, not printed). ARK carries no by-elections but confirms Reid (DUP/UUUC) topped Area A in 1977.

note: By-election of 28 November 1973 for one seat in Cookstown Area A (Cookstown District Council), caused by the disqualification of Republican Clubs councillor Gerry McElhatton, elected May 1973, for not returning his declaration of acceptance of office; the council could not agree unanimously on a co-option (SDLP proposed McElhatton, loyalists proposed Reid), so a poll was held.
